summary: A Yes vote establishes a business license tax of up to 10 cents per square foot on qualifying non-e-commerce industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, and truck-yard facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would impose a business license tax on certain warehouses and industrial facilities, generating revenue for the city general fund.
tax.quote: The measure proposes a business license tax of up to 10 cents per square foot of area of warehouses and industrial facilities.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the proposed business license tax.
